perOption.label: (A) that
perOption.reason: Copular structure [The nature of an ethical issue ... is [that-CP]]. A that-clause as subject complement of 'be' is fully licensed (cf. 'The problem is that...'). The clause following 'that' is complete ('there is no clear right or wrong response'), exactly what complementizer 'that' requires; no relative reading is needed.

perOption.label: (B) follow
perOption.reason: 'learn to think through ethical issues rather than follow...' — 'rather than' coordinates with the infinitival complement of 'learn'; after 'rather than', the bare infinitive is standard when the first conjunct is a to-infinitive (shared 'to' at the parallel start point). Grammatical.

perOption.label: (C) defined
perOption.reason: 'being ethical is defined as acting...' — gerund subject + passive 'be defined as' + gerund complement; canonical passive of 'define X as Y'. Grammatical.

perOption.label: (D) relating
perOption.reason: Subject is the free relative 'What a person values' (finite 'values' taking 'what' as object). With 'relating' as a participle, the sentence has no finite matrix verb: 'influenced by...' can only be a passive participle (no object, so not an active past-tense verb), leaving a fragment. Rescue parses fail: (i) 'relating to X' as reduced modifier still leaves no main verb; (ii) 'values' as noun fails ('a person values' would need a possessive); (iii) eliding 'is' before 'influenced' is not licensed. Required repair: finite 'relates' — 'What a person values relates to their social, religious, or civic beliefs, influenced by their formal and informal learning experiences.'

perOption.label: (E) to understand
perOption.reason: Extraposition: expletive 'it' + 'is necessary' + to-infinitive real subject; 'understand' takes the coordinated objects (NP 'the personal factors...' and the how-clause). Grammatical.

note: Single clean error: (D) creates a verbless sentence (fragment); all alternative parses that would legitimize 'relating' were checked and fail. (A)(B)(C)(E) each survive formal scrutiny under their governing rules, so no second defensible answer exists. Blind solve; lens: grammarian/logician.
